captions.detailed: This 3D model features a wide, shallow, elliptical bowl resting on a low rectangular base or foot. The bowl has an elongated oval shape with smooth, curved edges, resembling a decorative serving platter or dish. The rectangular foot is centered underneath, providing a stable, flat support structure that conforms to the bottom curvature of the bowl.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable, parametric elliptical bowl with an integrated flat rectangular base in OpenSCAD. Allow users to adjust the overall bowl width, height, and thickness, as well as the width, height, and thickness of the supporting foot.
captions.factory: The code generates the bowl by taking the difference of two resized spheres (using the `resize` function with `bowlWidth`, `bowlHeight`, and `bowlThickness` parameters), with the inner sphere translated slightly upward to hollow it out. The foot is created from a `cube` primitive resized to `footWidth`, `footHeight`, and `footThickness`, from which the same resized bowl sphere is subtracted using a `difference` operation to ensure the foot perfectly matches the curved underside of the bowl.
